# Flood insurance data

> Per-county NFIP flood-insurance statistics from public FEMA data: what policyholders pay, the gap to FEMA's full-risk price, claims history, flood risk, and CRS discounts.

## Pages
- [Lee County](https://floodinsurancedata.com/flood-insurance/lee-county-fl/): median $1,658
- [Kanawha County](https://floodinsurancedata.com/flood-insurance/kanawha-county-wv/): median $1,450
- [Methodology](https://floodinsurancedata.com/methodology/)
- [Data CSV](https://floodinsurancedata.com/data/counties.csv)

Source: FEMA OpenFEMA. Not endorsed by FEMA. Aggregates only.
